## What changes

- Rules added / changed / deprecated:
- Candidates accepted or rejected:

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruleset.yaml` version bumped (patch = wording, minor = new rule or target, major = removed or meaning changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] `added_in` / `changed_in` set on each touched rule
- [ ] No unresolved `conflicts_with` between active rules
- [ ] Nothing confidential (clients under NDA) in rules, sources or tests
